analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The head-side hunk (lines 595-611) adds documentation of a Gated DeltaNet four-row recurrence prefill kernel for qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35. It describes a per-process bit-exact probe on a fixed window with fallback to the stock kernel, and a DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED override. The supplied units are BASE text excerpts of the same file (lines 1638-2205), outside the changed hunk, so they supply surrounding context only. I found no changed security control, endpoint, key handling, attestation, authorization or encryption behavior. The docs make no claim that weakens T-041, TB-007 or the prefix-cache posture. Residual points are outside the supplied evidence: the actual kernel code in libs/mlx-swift-lm GatedDelta.swift is not in this batch. Whether the bit-for-bit probe truly preserves recurrent state for checkpoint capture (the prefix-cache SSD path, T-041) cannot be verified here. The documentation reads as a correctness and performance claim, not a new attack surface. The DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED env var is an operator-local control and does not touch the trust boundaries. The threat model needs no update because of this change. A reviewer of the code PR, if any, should check the kernel, the probe's memory use and the checkpoint-state equivalence.
